text: dsh-plugins-hub 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的社区插件市场，提供网页目录标签页和五个 agent 工具。用户可搜索并筛选插件、查看详情和相似插件、浏览热门排序，还能生成指定 profile 的安装命令。浏览器目录页通过侧栏扩展注册；工具在 DSH 中注册，供 agent 查询市场信息。它适合想发现和比较 DSH 插件的用户。运行时通过 dsh-plugins-mp.com API 获取目录与详情，无需额外 API 密钥。

dsh-plugins-hub adds a plugin catalog tab to DSH web and registers five agent tools. Search and filter plugins, inspect details and alternatives, browse rankings, and create profile-specific install commands. It uses the dsh-plugins-mp.com API and needs no API key.
想按类别和客户端 profile 搜索 DSH 插件。
有没有办法查看某个社区插件的介绍和兼容信息？
Help me find popular DSH plugins and compare alternatives.
dsh-plugins-hub 的功能「搜索与发现」：agent 可通过 mp_search 按关键词、分类、profile 和排序条件查询市场目录，并得到插件摘要和安装命令；mp_similar 可按插件 slug 返回相似推荐。
dsh-plugins-hub 的功能「详情与安装指令」：mp_details 查询插件介绍、版本和兼容信息；mp_install 按 slug 与 profile 生成供用户执行的 DSH 安装命令。
dsh-plugins-hub 使用市场功能时会向 dsh-plugins-mp.com API 发起目录或详情查询请求；代码允许配置 API 地址，默认地址为该站点。源码未声明必需 API 密钥。

dsh-plugins-hub README · dsh-plugins-hub：DeepSeek Harness plugin marketplace client: a catalog tab for
[DSH better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) + agent tools
(`mp_search`, `mp_similar`, `mp_details`, `mp_install`, `mp_trending`) over the API of
[dsh-plugins-mp.com](https://dsh-plugins-mp.com).

dsh-plugins-hub README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugins-hub
```

(after the npm release; before that — `add github:maryasov/dsh-plugins-hub`).

The "Marketplace" tab appears in the sidebar when `dsh-better-sidebar` is installed
(soft dependency: without it the plugin just skips the tab). Host-side tools always work.

dsh-plugins-hub README · Agent tools：| Tool | What it does | |---|---| | `mp_search` | catalog search (text, category, profile, sorting) + install commands | | `mp_similar` | similar plugins (vector search) | | `mp_details` | full profile: localized description, versions, per-DSH-release sandbox compatibility, tags | | `mp_install` | builds the `dsh plugin --profile

add ` command (executes nothing) | | `mp_trending` | popular plugins: by stars / downloads / updates |
dsh-plugins-hub README · Agent tools：Responses are localized (en / zh / ru via the `lang` parameter).

dsh-plugins-hub README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build        # tsdown: node half (ESM) + client half (CJS closure)
pnpm typecheck
```

Try it in DSH: `dsh plugin --profile mp-test add <path to this repo>` →
`dsh --profile mp-test --dump-config` (exit 0 = bundle mounted).

The `lib/` artifacts are committed, so installing from git requires no build
(ecosystem convention — `@deepseek-ai/*` stay external and resolve from the host).

dsh-plugins-hub README · Development：The marketplace platform sources live in the private repository
`maryasov/dsh-plugins-marketplace`.
